example_post_entry.hook: POV: Your dog becomes a Renaissance painting for $9
example_post_entry.caption: Full caption text here...

viral.action: Create variant videos, post follow-up content, boost with $100/day

medium.action: Monitor for 48h, consider $20/day boost if trending upward

baseline.action: No ad spend, keep posting organic

underperforming.action: Analyze failure - was it hook, audio, timing, or image? Adjust next post.

daily_tracking_checklist: Log into TikTok Analytics at 10am PT (1 hour after morning post)
Log into Instagram Insights at 10am PT
Record 24h metrics for previous day's posts
Check Google Analytics for website traffic spikes
Review top-performing post and identify why it worked
Adjust next day's content based on learnings
Check TikTok Creative Center for new trending audio
weekly_analysis_tasks: Calculate average engagement rate across all posts
Identify top 3 performing image styles (Renaissance, Pixar, etc.)
Calculate total website traffic from social media
Decide which posts to boost with ad spend

tiktok_analytics.access: TikTok app → Profile → Menu → Analytics (requires Pro account)
tiktok_analytics.key_metrics: Video views, Profile views, Followers, Content insights

instagram_insights.key_metrics: Reach, Engagement, Follower demographics, Content performance

stripe_dashboard.track: Revenue, Order volume, Customer acquisition cost

engagement_rate_formula.viral_indicator: If engagement rate > 15% in first 2 hours, post is likely to go viral

memorial_tribute_angle.note: Sensitive content - use sparingly, only when authentic

morning_9am_PT.note: Captures East Coast lunch scroll, West Coast morning coffee

evening_6pm_PT.note: Captures East Coast evening wind-down, West Coast after-work

rules: If Pixar 3D consistently outperforms other styles, increase Pixar posts to 40% of calendar
If morning slot underperforms, shift one post to lunch (12pm PT) or late night (9pm PT)
If memorial/tribute hooks spike engagement, create dedicated series but space out (max 1 per week)
If TikTok outperforms Instagram Reels by 2x, prioritize TikTok and cross-post to Reels
If video template 1 (before/after split) gets 2x views vs template 2, use template 1 for 60% of content

reporting_dashboard.daily_snapshot: Top post of the day, total views, total revenue
reporting_dashboard.weekly_summary: Total views, total followers gained, total revenue, top 5 posts, key insights
reporting_dashboard.monthly_summary: Campaign ROI, cost per acquisition, customer lifetime value, viral hits count, overall learnings
